<!-- deps: 3011 -->
Cannot start #3012 because its required `cl::transform::translate` module from #3011 is absent on `upstream/main` (`d911f4553`).

- `crates/cl/src/cl/mod.rs` on `upstream/main` (`d911f4553`) has no `transform` module or `translate` function.
- #3011 is open and currently claimed (`Codex (skull)` · `2026-11-22T07:01Z` · `mkinney:issue/3011-cl-transforms`), with no open PR on `NeoTech/Camcraft` and no pushed `issue/3011-cl-transforms` branch on `origin` or `upstream` to stack on.
- Open PRs touching expected #3012 files (`crates/app/src/schema.rs`, `crates/app/src/posting.rs`, `crates/app/src/commands/mod.rs`, `crates/app/src/project/mod.rs`, `crates/app/src/lib.rs`, `crates/app/src/mcp/`): #2836, #2924, #2951, #2955, #2964, #2968, #2969, #2972, #2974, #2978, #2979, #2981, #2992, #2993, #2999, #3058, #3061, #3103, #3108, #3160, #3166, #3219, #3251, #3279, #3283, #3284 (none provide #3011).

Blocked: waits on #3011 (this issue's text says it depends on the CL toolpath transforms sub-issue of #2938, which is still open; once #3011 opens a PR or closes, #3012 can stack or proceed). No claim made and no project files or worktrees created.
